top_signals.title: Adnoc Gas CFO: Still Exploring Opportunities in Fujairah
top_signals.summary: Adnoc Gas reported net income for 3Q of $1.34 billion that beat analyst estimates. The company says it remains on track to restore Habshan to full capacity by 2Q 2027 after damages during Iran War interceptions. Peter van Driel CFO of Adnoc Gas spoke to Bloomberg’s Abeer Abu Omar on Horizons Middle East & Africa on the earnings, their plans in Fujairah, and potential expansion to meet European gas needs. (Source: Bloomberg)
